t: This is St Sarkis, an Armenian Apostolic church on Iverna Gardens in Kensington, and it's Grade II* listed. It's the only church in England built in the traditional Armenian style, with a design inspired by the thirteenth-century bell tower of Haghpat Monastery. Calouste Gulbenkian, the businessman nicknamed Mr. Five Per Cent for his share of the Turkish Petroleum Company, paid for it in 1922 and 1923 as a memorial to his parents, and he is buried here. Arthur Davis was the architect. Today it is the seat of the Armenian Church's Diocese of the United Kingdom.
